text: Select: md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles; Source: molecule_dictionary md, compound_records cr, docs d, compound_structures cs; Join: md.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND md.molregno = cs.molregno; Filter: d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1131436' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL; Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC; Limit: null; Distinct: true
